## ResolvableCollectionReferenceData type

Data of a collection reference to `Resources` that a client can resolve: the resource has `list`<!-- -->, its container (for a selector collection) has `get`<!-- -->, and for an identity collection the resource also has `get`<!-- -->, through which each entry resolves. A selector collection carries the identity container of its `list`<!-- -->'s parent, and each entry that of its `get`<!-- -->'s parent, when the operation records one.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ResolvableCollectionReferenceData<Resources extends ResourceTable> = {
  [Key in ResolvableResourceKey<Resources, 'many'>]:
    | (Key extends ResolvableResourceKey<Resources, 'one'>
        ? IdentityCollectionReferenceData<ResourceIdOf<Resources, Key>, Key> & {
            readonly entries: readonly (IdentityReferenceData<ResourceIdOf<Resources, Key>, Key> &
              ResolvableContainmentOf<Resources, Key, 'get'>)[]
          }
        : never)
    | (SelectorCollectionReferenceData<Key> & ResolvableContainmentOf<Resources, Key, 'list'>)
}[ResolvableResourceKey<Resources, 'many'>]
```
